description:
The Ministry of Health has updated the Child Health protocol. You need to update the 'Child Programme' in DHIS2 to collect data on 'Chlorhexidine Gel Applied' during the 'Birth' stage. 

1. Create a new Data Element named 'Chlorhexidine Gel Applied' with Short Name 'Chlorhexidine', Domain Type 'Tracker', and Value Type 'Yes/No'. 
2. Add this data element to the 'Birth' Program Stage of the 'Child Programme'. 
3. Configure the data element in this stage to be 'Compulsory' and set to 'Display in Reports'. 

Login credentials: admin / district
